question: Who became the second lieutenant governor of Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manoj Sinha__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manoj Sinha is an Indian politician and is the current Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir.

 
 
• He served as the Minister of State for Railways and Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Communications in the Government of India.
 
• Mr. Sinha represented Ghazipur for three terms from the Bharatiya Janata Party and he was elected as Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha.
 
• Shri Sinha took over as the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir on August 7, 2020, after the resignation of Shri Girish Chandra Murmu.
 
• Prior to this appointment, Shri Sinha had served as the Minister of State for Railways and Minister of State for Communications in the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Shri Praful Patel **is a former Union Minister and Member of Parliament from Maharashtra. 
 
• **Shri Girish Chandra Murmu, was the first Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir after it became a Union Territory in 2019. **He resigned from the position in August 2020 and was succeeded by Shri Manoj Sinha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In the constitution of India, a Lieutenant Governor is the constitutional head of five of the eight union territories. The L-G is appointed by the President of India for a term of five years and holds office at the President's pleasure.
 
• The President of India shall appoint the Lieutenant Governor under Article 239 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Lieutenant Governor will be assisted by advisors appointed by the Centre since the Union Territory will not have a Legislative Assembly. 
 
• The Chief Minister shall be appointed by the Lieutenant Governor who will also appoint other ministers with the aid of the CM.
 
• The Lieutenant Governor will have the power to promulgate ordinances that shall have the same force and effect as an act of the Legislative Assembly assented by the LG.
 
• Since the union territories of Jammu and Kashmir, Puducherry, and Delhi have a measure of self-government with an elected legislature and council of ministers, the role of the lieutenant governor there is mostly a ceremonial one, akin to that of a state's governor.
 
• In Ladakh and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, however, the lieutenant governor holds more power, being both the head of state and head of government.
 
• The other three union territories Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Chandigarh, and Lakshadweep are governed by an administrator.
